pages.text: Emberveil runs about sixty mods. Good starting points:$(br2)$(li)Give Minecraft $(l)6 GB$() of memory (4 GB minimum; 8 GB for the High shader profile at long render distance).

In your launcher this is the Java memory or "Max memory" setting.$(li)Render distance 8 to 12 chunks, simulation distance 6 to 8.$(li)Use the Performance shader profile, or press <key:iris.keybind.toggleShaders>, on laptops and older graphics cards.
Sodium's Video Settings screen has extra options (under Quality and Performance). Entity Culling and ImmediatelyFast work without any setup.
Big structures generate in the background the first time you pass near them, so the first minutes in a new area can stutter briefly. That settles once the chunks exist.
